title: Sole Source OEM "Jered, LLC" - Hose Assembly Part(s)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC PUGET SOUND.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR PUGET SOUND
detail_text: THIS IS A FIRM FIXED-PRICE SUPPLY-TYPE PROCUREMENT NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound, in support of SRF-JRMC, is soliciting a SOLE SOURCE OEM "Jered, LLC" requirement for the procurement of Hose Assembly Part(s) . Please see the attached solicitation document(s) for requirement details. Prospective offeror(s) are responsible for downloading their own copy of the solicitation from this website, and for frequently monitoring that site for any amendments. The Government is not responsible for any inability of the offeror(s) to access any of the posted solicitation documents. This solicitation closes 26 MAR 2026 @ 1200 PDT. All questions regarding this solicitation should be submitted to the Contract Specialist - Walid Aslan (walid.m.aslan.civ@us.navy.mil).
